cbt3_rule_line8: 1. Visit the event page and form a 3-player team by inviting 2 others via your link.
cbt3_rule_line9: 2. Pre-register for Arknights: Endfield to get the SKPORT cosmetic item. Once all team members pre-register, you'll receive a random Team Key confirming your successful team-up.
cbt3_rule_line10: 3. Once your team is successfully formed, all members are locked in — no quitting or kicking allowed. You can only join ONE team during the event. If you haven't formed a team yet, keep trying until all sets of coordinates are unlocked.
cbt3_rule_line12: 1.There are 99 Key types in total. Every team gets one at random.
cbt3_rule_line13: 2.Each Key is tied to only one correct set of coordinates.
cbt3_rule_line15: 1.Once the file transfer countdown is over, teams with a Key can select any still-locked sets of coordinates in the file to unlock.
cbt3_rule_line16: 2.Each team member can attempt one unlock per day. Each team can unlock up to three times daily.
cbt3_rule_line17: 3.If any team member unlocks the correct set of coordinates, all members of the team will receive Beta Test II access for Arknights: Endfield. Other teams with the same Key will earn raffle tickets instead, based on how many sets of coordinates they've unlocked.
cbt3_rule_line18: 4.Once all sets of coordinates in the file have been unlocked, the raffle phase begins.
cbt3_rule_line20: 1.Use raffle tickets to enter the draw, with one chance per ticket. Prizes are awarded as shown on the results screen. The raffle closes when the recruitment for Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II ends.
cbt3_rule_line22: (1) Unlock sets of coordinates as described in the rules above
cbt3_rule_line23: (2) Complete specified tasks to earn additional raffle tickets
cbt3_rule_line25: Prizes are awarded through random draws. Supplies are limited, and depleted items will be removed from the pool. Fully redeemed prizes will no longer be available.
cbt3_rule_line26: Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II Access Distribution
cbt3_rule_line27: 1.Beta Test II access will be automatically granted to your Gryphline Account. No additional actions required.
cbt3_rule_line29: 1.Amazon Gift Cards will be sent via email. Be sure to register your email in [Prize History] at the top-right of the event page before the reward claim period ends.
cbt3_rule_line30: 2.The SKPORT limited avatar decorations will be auto-delivered via the SKPORT website.
cbt3_rule_line31: 3.Virtual rewards will be distributed within 30 business days after the reward claim period ends.
cbt3_rule_line33: Amazon Gift Cards are non-refundable and non-redeemable for cash. Details such as eligible items, services, and expiration dates are subject to the rules on your local Amazon website.
cbt3_rule_line35: 1.The test is restricted to adult players in their respective regions. Minors who receive test access through this event will not be able to log into the game. Please take note before participating.
cbt3_rule_line36: 2.All players share a single prize pool. No fixed quotas are set by region, and odds of winning depend on the actual number of participants. Amazon Gift Cards are only available in regions officially supported by Amazon.
cbt3_rule_line37: 3.Each Gryphline Account is limited to one Beta Test II access for Arknights: Endfield. Duplicate access will not be granted if your Gryphline Account already qualifies through other platforms. Sharing, selling, or transferring test access or game software is prohibited and may lead to your access being revoked or your SKPORT account suspended. Any illegal, improper, or fraudulent activity will also result in disqualification from the event.
cbt3_rule_line38: 4.If you are found to be cheating during the event (e.g., using technical exploits to obtain rewards), your event eligibility will be revoked. Any Arknights: Endfield test access or virtual rewards already granted will also be canceled.
cbt3_rule_line39: 5.If you fail to claim rewards as required for personal reasons (e.g., not submitting your email in time), SKPORT will not offer any compensation.
cbt3_rule_line40: 6.To send your Amazon Gift Card, SKPORT requires you to provide an email address. This information will only be used by SKPORT and authorized third-party service providers, and will not be shared with others without your consent. Please review SKPORT's Privacy Policy for more details on data protection. All personal information will be handled strictly under the Privacy Policy.
cbt3_rule_line41: 7.The event is hosted by SKPORT. Third-party rewards are offered solely for identification and reference, without implying any endorsement, sponsorship, or partnership between the third party and SKPORT or this event.
cbt3_rule_line42: 8.If you have tax obligations under the laws of your region, you are responsible for completing all related filings yourself.
cbt3_rule_line43: 9.For any questions about this event, please reach out via [Customer Support Email: skporthelp@gryphline.com].
